sources.title: GLM-5.3-Flash: Frontier Intelligence, Flash Cost - z.ai
sources.snippet: We introduce GLM-5.3-Flash, the first natively multimodal model in the GLM-5 series. With 320B total parameters and just 18B active parameters, it outperforms GLM-5.2 across benchmarks and real-world workloads at one-tenth the price, while approaching Claude Opus 4.8 on coding and agentic benchmarks.

sources.title: GLM 5.3 Flash | Cursor Docs
sources.snippet: GLM 5.3 Flash is the smaller, faster member of Z.ai's GLM 5.3 family. It supports image inputs, a 1M-token context window, and three reasoning levels (Low, High, and Max), with High as the default.

sources.snippet: GLM-5.3-Flash Description GLM-5.3-Flash is the first natively multimodal model in Z.ai's GLM-5 series. With 320B total parameters and 18B active per token, it outperforms GLM-5.2 across benchmarks and real-world workloads at roughly one-tenth the price, approaching Claude Opus 4.8 on coding and agentic benchmarks.
